Formal evidence

Exact family, limited control objective

Distributed tangential actuation regulates circulation speed and hence tension. The curve is prescribed as a periodic unit-speed shape. This is an exact invariant family; it is not a theorem of attraction or stability for arbitrary shape perturbations.
